tasks.spec: cp -r /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39b/gw-datetime-tolerance/gw ./gw && cp /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW39b/gw-datetime-tolerance/proof_parse.py . && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_parse.py > proof.out 2>&1 && cd gw && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; tail -2 pytest.out; cat proof.out; exit $rc
